in_hebrew.name: Craig
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Rock, crag, promontory
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Craig הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Craig comes from either Old Norse 'kraik' or Gaelic 'crag'. It means 'rock, crag, or promontory'. The name has been traditionally used in Scotland, and has since spread beyond Scottish borders. There is no direct Biblical or Christian origin for the name Craig.
